BEFORE THE PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
                 OF THE STATE OF MISSOURI
 In the Matter of Evergy Metro, Inc. d/b/a Evergy        )
 Missouri Metro’s Request for Authority to               )       Case No. ER-2026-0143
 Implement a General Rate Increase for Electric          )
 Service                                                 )

   ORDER DIRECTING THE FILING OF A JOINT ISSUES STATUS PLEADING
     AND SETTING TIME FOR OBJECTIONS TO COMMISSION EXHIBITS

Issue Date: October 27, 2026                                     Effective Date: October 27, 2026

       Six nonunanimous stipulations and agreements (Agreements) were filed in this

general rate case, which attempted to resolve specific disputed issues. At least three of

those Agreements were objected to and are position statements that no party is bound by,

and the other Agreements have not yet been addressed by the Commission.

       Some issues in the Agreements appear to be addressed in multiple Agreements and

other issues (Such as PISA and transmission costs) appear interdependent. The

Commission seeks clarity on the status of the issues. The Commission will direct the parties

to file a joint list noting the status of each issue in this case. The joint issues list must include:

The issue, whether the issue is addressed within the Agreements and which stipulation and

agreement addresses that issue, how that issue is addressed by a stipulation and

agreement, and what parties have objected to how the issue is addressed in the

Agreements.

       The Commission would also like to take official notice of the transcript from the

October 13, 2026, on-the-record presentation. Similarly, the Commission would like to take

the Agreements into evidence as exhibits. The Commission will set a time for objections to
 the Commission taking official notice of the transcripts or objections to the admission of the

Agreements into the hearing record.

THE COMMISSION ORDERS THAT:

          1.    The parties must file a joint list of issues as set forth in the body of this order

no later than November 6, 2026.

          2.    Any objections to the Commission taking official notice of the transcript of

the on-the-record presentation, or any objections to the Commission admitting the

Agreements into evidence must be filed no later than November 6, 2026.

                                            BY THE COMMISSION



                                            Nancy Dippell
                                            Secretary




John T. Clark, Senior Regulatory Law Judge,
by delegation of authority pursuant to
